main_body: Round leafy canopy (about 34x32 px) on a short trunk, with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Light and mid-light green canopy top, rows ~2-14, with the highest highlights toward the upper left and right
evidence: Down the middle column the canopy goes from a lighter, sunlit top mass (rows ~3-14) to a dark teal-green shadow band around rows 14-18. Below it the lit front of the lower canopy runs to a dark underside outline at row ~30, then the trunk (rows 32-42). It reads as a rounded volume lit from above with a shaded underside, not a flat elevation. There is no hard front-edge line, which is normal for foliage.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 greens (deep teal, dark, mid, light, highlight) and a dark green-teal outline rather than near-black, which matches the Beodeul approach. The texture is blotchy noise rather than defined leaf clumps with per-clump highlights, so it reads softer and thinner than the references. The trunk is a narrow, mostly flat brown column with little bark grain and no branches or root flare. The grass patch is nearly flat. Overall it is slightly less rich than the references and would look a little blobby beside them.
